versions.content: If CanNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE and CanNm_ActivateTxPnShutdownMs g is called with a valid NM - Channel ( nmChannelHandle ), then the Can Nm module shall consider the PN shutdown message transmission as active on the given NM - channel, set PNSR bit in the CBV to 1 and return with E_OK .
